text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Gold Ship comes to the trainer's office…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Why, hello there, Trainer. Sure is lovely weather we're having today, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Goodness, why do you look so startled?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I daresay you seem a little off today. Are you feeling well?
choice_data_list: You don't seem like yourself, either.
You don't seem like yourself, either.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well… If you must know, I've been having strange headaches of late.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …Ah, speaking of which, I feel one coming right now—ow, ow, OW!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whaaa? I'm the one and only Golshi! Who else would I be?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ugh… All that shouting's made my headache even worse…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship seems to be plagued by bad migraines.
